title: Conjugated chemical degradation inducers and methods of use
abstract: The subject matter described herein relates to antibody-CIDE conjugates (Ab-CIDE), pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, and their use in treating diseases and conditions in which targeted protein degradation is beneficial.

title: Compounds for inhibiting or degrading target proteins, compositions, comprising the same, methods of their making, and methods of their use
abstract: Provided herein are heterobifunctional compounds which find utility as modulators of targeted ubiquitination. Also provided herein are pharmaceutically acceptable compositions comprising said compounds and methods of using the compounds, and compositions in the treatment of various diseases, conditions, or disorders.

title: Process for preparing a composition comprising a protein d polypeptide
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for preparing immunogenic compositions. More particularly, it relates to a process for preparing liquid compositions of Protein D polypeptide and their use in preparing immunogenic compositions comprising Protein D polypeptide which may be used in the treatment or prevention of an acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) in a subject, e.g. human.

title: Compound radix puerariae, radix scutellariae and coptis chinensis soup, and method and effect thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction, a method and an effect thereof, 1) a non-alcoholic fatty liver disease mouse model is established, 2) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease metagenome and metabonomics analysis, 3) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for improving the lipid disorder of the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease through the regulation and control of TGR5 by intestinal flora metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid, and then a liver cancer cell line lipid deposition model is established; 4) Bacterial outer vesicles can localize to the liver and exert biological effects on non-alcoholic fatty liver disease; the invention discovers that the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root soup can improve host NAFLD diseases through AKK bacteria and metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid; akk the metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid may improve NAFLD lipid disorders through TGR5 modulation.

title: Anti-ubiquitinyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical biology, and relates to an anti-lysyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof. The anti-pan LOX family nano antibody or antigen binding fragment comprises three complementarity determining regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3, wherein the amino acid sequence of the CDR1 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 1-SEQ ID NO:8, the amino acid sequence of the CDR2 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 9-SEQ ID NO:17, and the amino acid sequence of the CDR3 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 18-SEQ ID NO: 26. The invention screens the library by using a flow panning method to finally obtain the anti-human/mouse anti-pan LOX family nano antibody gene sequence. The anti-pan-LOX family nano antibody has the advantages of small molecular weight, high affinity and better specificity. Has good prospect for diagnosing fibrosis.

title: Imaging device and electronic instrument
abstract: Provided is an imaging device comprising: a semiconductor substrate that has a pixel region of a plurality of imaging elements arranged in an array, and an outer peripheral portion surrounding the pixel region; a glass substrate that is provided above the semiconductor substrate; a first sealing material that covers the outer peripheral portion of the semiconductor substrate and seals a gap between the semiconductor substrate and the glass substrate; and a plurality of columnar bodies that is provided on the semiconductor substrate on the inner side of the first sealing material.

title: Electro-optical device and electronic device
abstract: An electro-optical device may include a first substrate, a second substrate, a seal member extending in a first direction and disposed between the first and second substrates in a seal region defined around a pixel area, a first conductive layer disposed between the first substrate and the seal member and extending in a second direction intersecting with the first direction, a second conductive layer disposed between the first substrate and the first conductive layer and extending in the second direction, a third layer disposed in the pixel area and formed of the first conductive layer, and a fourth layer disposed in the pixel area and formed of the second conductive layer. In plan view, the first conductive layer overlaps the second conductive layer in the seal region. In a cross-sectional view the first direction, the second conductive layer is larger in an outer shape than the first conductive layer.

title: Solid-state imaging device
abstract: Provided is a solid-state imaging device capable of matching the influence of incident light with respect to a light-blocking film between an image height center and a position at which the image height is raised. The solid-state imaging device comprises a semiconductor substrate having a plurality of pixels arranged in a matrix thereon. Each of the plurality of pixels comprises: a photoelectric conversion section for generating charge by photoelectric conversion based on light incident on a light-receiving surface of the semiconductor substrate; a charge storage section for storing the charge generated by the photoelectric conversion section; a transfer transistor including a vertical gate electrode reaching the photoelectric conversion section, the transfer transistor transferring the charge from the photoelectric conversion section to the charge storage section; and a light-blocking section formed by a trench disposed in a layer between the light-receiving surface and the charge storage section, the light-blocking section blocking entry into the charge storage section of light entering via the light-receiving surface. The amount of coverage of the light-blocking section with respect to the charge storage section is corrected in accordance with the image height at the position at which the pixels are disposed.

title: Pad structure for front side illuminated image sensor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor structure. The semiconductor structure includes a dielectric layer having a first dielectric surface and a second dielectric surface opposite to the first dielectric surface. The dielectric layer defines a recess in the first dielectric surface, and the recess includes a sidewall of the dielectric layer. A first conductive layer contacts a bottom surface of the dielectric layer. The sidewall of the dielectric layer is directly over the first conductive layer. A second conductive layer contacts the first conductive layer and the dielectric layer. The second conductive layer vertically extends from the first conductive layer to above the dielectric layer. A third conductive layer contacts the second conductive layer. The third conductive layer is laterally separated from a sidewall of the second conductive layer that faces the third conductive layer by a non-zero distance.

title: Photodetection device, method for manufacturing photodetection device, and electronic apparatus
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a photodetection device, a method of manufacturing the photodetection device, and an electronic device, which are capable of improving a light condensing effect of a microlens in units of pixels and improving optical characteristics. The photodetection device includes pixels each including a photoelectric conversion section that photoelectrically converts incident light, a microlens that condenses the incident light on the photoelectric conversion section, and a plurality of protrusions formed on the microlens. The pixels each include two or more of the protrusions in which at least one of a width, a height, or a density is different. The present disclosure can be applied to, for example, a solid-state imaging device or the like.

title: Low-carbon emission factory air filtering device
abstract: The invention discloses a low-carbon emission factory air filtering device which comprises a water storage tank and a filter box, wherein a cooling sedimentation chamber, a heat exchange chamber and a filter chamber are arranged in the filter box, a distribution chamber is arranged in the water storage tank, a mounting frame is arranged in the middle of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a filter screen is arranged in the mounting frame, a rack is welded on one side of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a gear is meshed with the bottom of the rack, a brush roller is welded on the side face of the gear, a moving mechanism is arranged outside the cooling sedimentation chamber, a spray head is arranged at the top of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a coil pipe is fixedly arranged in the heat exchange chamber, a water suction pump is arranged at the bottom of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a heat conducting plate is arranged in the heat exchange chamber, the top end of the heat conducting plate stretches into the water storage tank, and the heat conducting plates are alternately arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the heat exchange chamber. The invention utilizes a plurality of working procedures to cool and absorb heat to the gas, thereby avoiding a large amount of heat from being directly discharged and increasing the utilization rate of resources; the impurity on filter screen surface clearance more thoroughly, impurity direct clearance is outside to the rose box, avoids piling up in inside and is difficult to clear.

title: Improved structure of temperature and pressure reducer of condenser
abstract: The utility model discloses a condenser temperature and pressure reduction ware improves structure relates to condenser technical field. The utility model discloses a casing and transport pipe, the inner wall of casing from left to right is fixed with cooling tube, protection casing and throttle plate, and the upper end of the fixed atomising head of protection casing inner wall is fixed with the connecting pipe, the connecting pipe runs through the upper end of casing, the upper end of casing is fixed with the cooling water admission pipe, and the lower extreme of casing from left to right is fixed with cooling water discharge pipe and drain pipe in proper order, be fixed with the relief pressure valve on the transport pipe. Can carry the cooling tube with water through cooling water admission pipe and cooling water discharge pipe in, then utilize the temperature of hot transferability can tentatively reduce steam, then the water pump is pumped and is sent water to the atomising head blowout through the connecting pipe, and the temperature of steam can further be reduced to spun water, and two-stage cooling effect is better, later can tentatively reduce pressure through the throttle plate, further reduces pressure through the relief pressure valve afterwards, and two-stage decompression effect is all good.

title: Gas jet kitchen ventilator
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, in particular to an air jet range hood. The negative pressure gas receiving cover of the device is internally provided with a jet pipe with a closed lower end, an air booster is arranged outside the negative pressure gas receiving cover, the air outlet end of the air booster is connected with an air pressure stabilizing device, the air outlet end of the air pressure stabilizing device is communicated with the inside of the jet pipe through a pipeline, the upper end of the negative pressure gas receiving cover is connected with a diffusion pipe, the upper end of the diffusion pipe is connected with a mixing pipe, the upper end of the mixing pipe is connected with a one-way valve, and the outlet of the upper end of the jet pipe extends into the diffusion pipe. The utility model realizes that negative pressure is generated by jet flow, the negative pressure difference is large, the adsorption force is strong, the efficiency is high, a fan is not adopted, the phenomenon that the rotating blades accumulate heavy oil stains to cause the oil fume adsorption effect is greatly reduced, an exhaust air flow channel is unobstructed, and the workload of cleaning the range hood is greatly reduced.

title: Liquid accumulator and compressor
abstract: The utility model provides a reservoir and compressor, wherein, the reservoir includes: the device comprises a cylinder, an air inlet pipe, an exhaust pipe and a reinforcing plate; the barrel is provided with an inner cavity, the air inlet pipe is inserted into the barrel from the upper end of the barrel, the lower end of the air inlet pipe is closed, the side surface of the air inlet pipe is provided with an air outlet, and the air inlet pipe is communicated with the inner cavity through the air outlet; one end of the exhaust pipe and the air inlet pipe are inserted into the inner cavity of the cylinder body at a certain distance, and the other end of the exhaust pipe is positioned outside the cylinder body; the reinforcing plate is fixed on the inner wall of the barrel around the exhaust pipe, at least one filter hole is formed in the reinforcing plate, and a filter screen is arranged in the filter hole. In the reservoir and the compressor that this application provided, the reinforcing plate that the adoption has the filtration pore cooperatees with the intake pipe that adopts the side exhaust, not only can avoid rubbish to fall into in the blast pipe, can improve the effective volume of reservoir moreover, reduces the subassembly of reservoir, simplifies the assembly process of reservoir, and then reduces the manufacturing cost of reservoir and compressor.

title: Closed water inlet air temperature adjusting device
abstract: The invention discloses a closed water inlet air temperature regulating device which comprises an inlet air preheating unit, an impurity removing unit, a filter screen plate, a cleaning component, an impurity collecting component and a vibrating component, wherein the inlet air preheating unit comprises an inlet air heater shell, an air inlet arranged on the inlet air heater shell, a spraying component arranged inside the inlet air heater shell, the impurity removing unit is arranged inside the inlet air heater shell, the filter screen plate is arranged on the filter screen plate, the impurity collecting component is arranged below the filter screen plate, and the vibrating component is arranged below the filter screen plate. The gas entering the air inlet heater shell can be sprayed and heated by the spraying component, and the gas after being sprayed and heated can be dried by the drying unit, so that the gas entering the gas turbine is effectively preheated, and the efficiency of the gas turbine is improved.

title: IOT equipment control interface display method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a display method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a control interface of IOT equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps that a user side obtains a first image related to the IOT equipment and sends the first image to a control center, and the control center identifies an equipment identification number through a set machine learning algorithm model; if the control center successfully identifies, the control center returns the equipment identification number, and the user side displays a corresponding control interface; if the control center fails to recognize, the control center returns an equipment identification number list, the user side selects an equipment identification number according to a user instruction and sends a first image storage signal to the control center, the control center stores a first image recognized by the user into an image training set, and the image training set comprises images marked with the equipment identification number and is used for training a machine learning algorithm model. The invention automatically displays the control interface of the IOT equipment through image recognition, and solves the problem that the manual searching of the equipment control interface is difficult and complicated caused by the increase of the IOT equipment.

title: Systems and methods for using non-identifiable sensor information to validate user information
abstract: A computer system operates to obtain profile activity information from a user device, including a device identifier and a set of sensor data. From the device sensor data, the computer system determines at least one of (i) a location fingerprint for at least a given location from where the set of sensor data was obtained, and (ii) a location-based behavior that is specific to a user of the user device for the given location. The device identifier is stored in association with the determined location fingerprint or location behavior. The computer system further determines at least one of a current or recent location fingerprint or location-based behavior from a current or recent set of sensor data. A comparison is then made as between the current or recent location fingerprint or location-based behavior and the location fingerprint or location-based behavior associated with the device identifier based on which outputs are generated.

title: Method and device for generating fault root cause positioning model
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a fault root cause positioning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical alarm data as sample data, and constructing a training set, wherein the historical alarm data corresponds to an alarm object, and the alarm object comprises any one or more network devices in a service platform; generating an alarm association rule according to the training set, wherein the alarm association rule is used for representing association relations among alarms generated by a plurality of alarm objects; and training to obtain a target fault root cause positioning model according to the alarm association rule, wherein the target fault root cause positioning model is used for positioning the fault root cause of the fault of the alarm object based on the fault propagation relation among the alarm objects.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum management and utilization
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum utilization management. The system includes at least one monitoring sensor, at least one data analysis engine, at least one application, a semantic engine, a programmable rules and policy editor, a tip and cue server, and/or a control panel. The tip and cue server is operable utilize the environmental awareness from the data processed by the at least one data analysis engine in combination with additional information to create actionable data.

title: Corroborating device-detected anomalous behavior
abstract: Described are techniques for corroborating anomalous behavior. The techniques include training devices included in an Internet of Things (IoT) mesh network to independently identify occurrences of anomalous behavior in a proximate physical environment. The techniques further include receiving event data from at least a portion of the devices in the IoT mesh network corresponding to a time window, where the event data reports occurrences of at least one type of anomalous behavior. The techniques further include corroborating the at least one type of anomalous behavior to determine that the occurrences of the at least one type of anomalous behavior indicate an anomalous event that meets a reporting threshold for providing notice of the anomalous event. The techniques further include generating a notification regarding the anomalous event.

title: Hinge seat and arm body
abstract: The utility model discloses a hinge seat and an arm body, wherein the hinge seat comprises a connecting plate, a pitching hinge lug plate and a side swinging hinge lug plate, the connecting plate is used for connecting a first side face of the arm body, the pitching hinge lug plate is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and provided with a first hinge hole for pitching driving of the arm body, and the side swinging hinge lug plate is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and provided with a second hinge hole for side swinging driving of the arm body. The utility model is applied to the field of engineering machinery, and the connecting plates are used as the connection transfer between the pitching hinge lug plate and the side swinging hinge lug plate and the arm body, so that the direct welding of the pitching hinge lug plate and the side swinging hinge lug plate and the arm body is avoided, and the problems of false welding or infirm welding caused by the fact that the thickness of the arm body is too small and the welding angle is too thin can be effectively solved.

title: Double-operation flue non-return mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a flue backstop mechanism of dual operation, including first flue and second flue, first flue through backstop mechanism with the second flue is connected, this backstop mechanism is through setting up driving motor, hand wheel, can ensure through the priority of adjustment operation that backstop mechanism possesses two kinds of operating methods, through the first knot piece that sets up mutual lock, the second is detained the piece and can be ensured first backstop, the relation of connection between the backstop board of second, through first backstop, the backstop board one end card of second is gone into and is held in the groove, can effectively inject first backstop, the removal of backstop board of second, through two knot pieces, the card is held the degree of freedom that groove and slide rail can restrict first backstop board completely, the backstop board of second, when it receives impact potential energy, can guarantee that structural connection does not change, under the prerequisite of guaranteeing former technological effect through simple structure, can protect the relation of connection of part better, make it can resist stronger impact potential energy.

title: Mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical accessory clamping device for mechanical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of clamping. A mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the base is fixedly connected with a box body, a driving mechanism and a gas collecting mechanism are arranged in the box body, the inner wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a partition plate and a stabilizer bar, a first avoidance groove is formed in the box body, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are rotationally connected to the box body, a first belt wheel and a second bevel gear are fixedly connected to the first screw rod, a second belt wheel and a third bevel gear are fixedly connected to the second screw rod, fixing blocks are in threaded connection with the first screw rod and the second screw rod, the fixing blocks are connected to the stabilizer bar in a sliding mode, the thread directions of the first screw rod and the second screw rod are opposite, and a clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of each fixing block; the automatic clamping device is simple to operate, can automatically clamp the accessories, can clean the accessories in the clamping and loosening processes, greatly saves labor and time, and improves production efficiency.

title: Guide rod cylinder positioning self-locking mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a guide rod cylinder positioning self-locking mechanism, which comprises: the device comprises a fixed seat, a linear cylinder, a pair of guide mechanisms and a push plate; the linear cylinder is connected with the fixed seat; the pair of guide mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the linear cylinder and are connected with the fixed seat; the push plate is respectively connected with the linear cylinder and the output end of the guide mechanism. The utility model has simple structure, high positioning precision and low cost.

title: Safety auxiliary device
abstract: The utility model discloses a safety auxiliary device, which comprises a fixed plate; the front surface of the fixing plate is rotatably provided with an extension mechanism, the front surface of the extension mechanism is fixedly provided with a support frame, one end of the inner wall of the support frame is fixedly provided with an anti-falling mechanism, the inside of the support frame is rotatably provided with a winding mechanism, and the outer side of the winding mechanism is wound with a safety rope main body; the extending mechanism comprises a bidirectional screw rod, a sleeve, a connecting rod and a connecting seat; according to the utility model, the bidirectional screw, the sleeve, the connecting rods and the connecting seat are matched for use, the sleeve can be driven to move by the rotation of the bidirectional screw, when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are maximum, the supporting frame can be positioned on the front of the fixed plate, the device is stored, the occupied space is reduced, and when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are reduced, one end of each connecting rod can be driven to drive the supporting frame to extend out for use, so that the device is beneficial to personnel.

title: Preparation method of yttrium oxide with large specific surface area
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of yttrium oxide with a large specific surface area, which comprises the following preparation steps of S1, dissolving yttrium salt, adding tetramethylammonium hydroxide for precipitation, S2, adding distilled water for washing, centrifugally dewatering, S3, washing with ethanol, dewatering, S4, adding diethylene glycol monobutyl ether, uniformly mixing to form paste, S5, burning the paste formed after the step S4 at a low temperature to form powder, S6, adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the powder prepared in the step S5 for ball milling, and S7, drying. The invention adopts tetramethyl ammonium hydroxide for precipitation, the space structure can reduce the agglomeration phenomenon, ethanol is adopted for washing for multiple times after washing, water is removed, diethylene glycol monobutyl ether solution is added to mix into paste, the agglomeration is further reduced during firing, and the firing temperature only needs 600-750 ℃, thereby saving energy and protecting environment. And during ball milling, absolute ethyl alcohol is added, no water is contained in the ball milling process, and agglomeration is reduced. The specific surface area of the yttrium oxide prepared by the method reaches 100-200m 2 /g.

title: Single crystal aluminum-rich cascade hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve and green preparation method thereof
abstract: A monocrystal aluminum-rich cascade hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve and a green preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of uniformly mixing a copolymer, deionized water, an aluminum source, an alkali source and a silicon source according to a certain proportion, carrying out hydrothermal crystallization, centrifuging and drying an obtained product, and removing a template agent through acid treatment to obtain the single crystal aluminum-rich stepped hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve. The copolymer can be used as a dispersing agent to effectively improve the fluidity of the aluminum-rich concentrated gel and inhibit the generation of mixed crystals, and can act with an aluminum source to promote the aluminum source to enter a molecular sieve framework and guide the synthesis of the single crystal aluminum-rich ZSM-5 molecular sieve. The ketal copolymer is stable under alkaline conditions and decomposed under acidic conditions, and can be removed from the molecular sieve structure only by acid treatment without roasting treatment. The ZSM-5 molecular sieve prepared by the method has Si/Al = 4-8, is a step pore molecular sieve, and has the advantages of high Al content, nano single crystal structure, high specific surface area and pore volume and the like.

title: Preparation method and water treatment method of COF MXene bacterial cellulose composite material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and a water treatment method of a COF MXene bacterial cellulose composite material, and synthesis of S1 COF nanosheets: s2 MXene nano-sheets are synthesized; s3 BC preparation; s4 BC/COF composite film preparation; s5 COF/MXene/BC composite film preparation method. The composite material with the acid-base synergistic catalytic function, which is prepared by the invention, is applied to the catalytic conversion of glucose to generate the 5-HMF, and the COF/MXene/BC composite film can improve the separation efficiency and reduce the energy consumption, thereby providing an effective solution for solving the problems of water resource and environmental pollution.

title: Substrate treating agent and metal material
abstract: The invention provides a substrate treating agent which can endow a metal material with preferable adhesion, acid resistance and alkali resistance to a laminated film. The concentration of the water-soluble metal compound in the substrate treating agent is 500 to 200,000 mass ppm in terms of metal atom, the number average molecular weight of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 70,000 ～ 500,000, the acid value of the solid content is 150 to 740mgKOH/g, the hydroxyl value of the solid content is 40 to 350mgKOH/g, the glass transition temperature of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is in the range of 63 to 100 ℃, the concentration of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 500 to 200,000 mass ppm in terms of the solid content, and the ratio of the metal atom-converted concentration of the water-soluble metal compound to the concentration of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 3/97 to 91/9. Substrate treating agents are used in the manufacture of laminated metallic materials.

title: Preparation method of layered double hydroxide nano-sheet and application of layered double hydroxide nano-sheet in removal of perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances in water body
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of layered double hydroxide nano sheets, and particularly relates to a preparation method of layered double hydroxide nano sheets and application thereof in removing perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in water. The invention mixes inorganic strong alkali, water-soluble aluminum salt, water-soluble divalent metal salt and water, and carries out coprecipitation reaction under the condition that the pH value is more than 10, and the obtained coprecipitation product is dispersed in water for hydrothermal crystallization treatment, thus obtaining the layered double hydroxide nano sheet. The invention only adopts water as a reaction solvent, prepares the layered double hydroxide nano-sheets by a coprecipitation assisted hydrothermal method, and the obtained layered double hydroxide nano-sheets have high purity and high yield, simultaneously reduce the production cost, are more environment-friendly and are suitable for industrial production. The layered double hydroxide nano-sheet provided by the invention has a rapid removal effect and an ultrahigh adsorption capacity on perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances, and is an adsorbent with application prospect in repairing PFAS in water.

title: Leftover material removing device for bag making machine production
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of leftover material removal, and discloses a leftover material removing device for producing a bag making machine, which is characterized in that the upper surface of a bottom plate is fixedly connected with a frame, a hydraulic rod is fixedly connected inside the frame, the bottom of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a motor shell, the inside of the motor shell is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the outer surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a polishing disc, an electric push rod is fixedly connected inside the frame, one end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the bottom of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a hairbrush, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an installation box, a fan is arranged inside the frame, the polishing disc is further used for polishing the unnecessary leftover material, and the operation of the device is time-saving, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title: Sheet material horizontal and vertical grooving machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a sheet transverse and vertical grooving machine, which comprises a conveying device and a grooving device connected with an inlet and an outlet of the conveying device, wherein the conveying direction of the grooving device positioned at the inlet is vertical to the conveying direction of the conveying device, and the conveying direction of the grooving device positioned at the outlet is the same as the conveying direction of the conveying device; the grooving device comprises a rack, a conveying belt, a first driving mechanism, a cutter shaft and a second driving mechanism, wherein the conveying belt is arranged on the rack, the first driving mechanism drives the conveying belt to operate, the cutter shaft is pivoted on the rack, and the second driving mechanism drives the cutter shaft to rotate so as to cut a sheet into groove bodies along the conveying direction. The utility model discloses sheet violently erects groover has full automatization operation, advantage that production efficiency is high.

title: Food processing material filament cutter
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to a food processing material shredder which comprises a lower fixing box and a fixing frame, wherein a fixing rod is fixedly arranged on the fixing frame, a fixing disc is fixedly arranged at the fixing rod, a cutting tool is fixedly arranged on the front end face of the fixing disc, an upper sealing box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the lower fixing box, a centrifugal barrel capable of rotating at a high speed is arranged between the lower fixing box and the upper sealing box, the fixing disc is positioned in the centrifugal barrel, protection plates are fixedly arranged at the front end parts of the lower fixing box and the upper sealing box, the protection plates are arranged in a front-back opening manner, a feeding port is fixedly arranged at the front end opening of each protection plate, evenly-distributed discharge ports are arranged on the centrifugal barrel, and the protection is carried out through the protection plates, so that a user can be effectively prevented from accidentally contacting a cutter in the operation process, the cutter is kept stationary in a centrifugal manner, and the operation safety is further improved.

title: Plate making device for plastic packaging product production
abstract: The utility model discloses a plate making device for plastic packaging product production, which comprises a machine body, wherein a workbench is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the machine body, a lifting device is arranged at the upper end of the machine body, a manufacturing device is arranged on the lifting device and is correspondingly arranged above the workbench, an equipment bin is arranged on one side of the upper end in the machine body, a flattening mechanism is arranged in the equipment bin, two lead screws are arranged on the flattening mechanism, and two ends of the two lead screws are respectively and rotatably connected to the opposite inner walls of the upper end of the machine body. The automatic flattening device can automatically flatten the material at the upper end of the workbench when the plate making device is operated, can effectively save the trouble of manual flattening, reduce the labor intensity of workers, and simultaneously can ensure the flattening effect of the material and improve the flattening efficiency, thereby ensuring the plate making effect of the plate making device and improving the plate making efficiency of the plate making device.

title: Screening equipment for preventing damage of pulping machine
abstract: The invention relates to the field of special equipment for pulping and papermaking, and particularly discloses screening equipment for preventing a pulping machine from being damaged; according to the invention, through arranging the base, the shell, the screen cylinder, the reducer connecting seat and the heavy slag pot, after the production personnel guides paper pulp into the shell, the reducer connecting seat drives the rotor to rotate, the rotating rotor can drive the paper pulp between the shell and the screen cylinder to rotate, impurities with heavier mass in the paper pulp can slide along the inner wall of the shell under the action of centrifugal force, the sliding heavy impurities can slowly fall into the slag hole after contacting with the slag baffle, the paper pulp can enter the screen cylinder through the holes of the screen cylinder under the action of the rotor, good pulp in the screen cylinder can be discharged from the discharge hole, the inner flow type structure is adopted, the heavy slag removing efficiency is high under the action of the centrifugal force, the service life of the screen cylinder of the rotor is long, and the heavy slag removing efficiency can be improved through the fence effect of the screen cylinder, so that the heavy slag which can damage the pulping machine and the fluffer can be removed as much as possible.

title: Program controlled attenuator
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of communication calibration measurement and automatic test, and discloses a program-controlled attenuator, wherein the power input end of the program-controlled attenuator is connected with a working power supply, the voltage of the working power supply is converted into an attenuation working voltage within a preset range by a voltage conversion circuit, a switch driving circuit is connected with a driving signal, and a first attenuation passage or a second attenuation passage is conducted by an attenuation gating circuit according to the driving signal when the attenuation gating circuit is connected with the attenuation working voltage.

title: Signal detection circuit, detection method, signal processing circuit and electronic device
abstract: The application discloses a signal detection circuit, a detection method, a signal processing circuit and electronic equipment, wherein the signal detection circuit comprises: the proportional amplifying circuit is coupled with the circuit to be detected so as to receive the signal to be detected sent by the circuit to be detected; the hysteresis circuit is coupled with the proportional amplifying circuit; the hysteresis circuit is used for receiving the signal to be detected sent by the proportional amplifying circuit, comparing the signal to be detected with a preset reference voltage, determining the amplifying proportion of the signal to be detected, and sending a control signal corresponding to the amplifying proportion to the proportional amplifying circuit; the proportional amplifying circuit is used for receiving the control signal and carrying out proportional amplification on the signal to be detected based on the amplification proportion; wherein the number of the amplification ratios is at least two. By the mode, the signal detection circuit can effectively ensure the detection precision of weak signals while not reducing the signal detection range.

title: Adaptive impedance matching apparatus and method for wireless power transfer
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method capable of performing immediate impedance matching according to changes of a distance and positions between TX/RX coils. The present invention includes: an impedance adjustment unit including a voltage-controlled variable capacitance device; a power detector configured to detect a reflection signal which enters the transmitter or receiver when there is no impedance matching to measure a magnitude of the reflection signal and convert the reflection signal into a DC signal; a multiplier configured to multiply the DC signal with a periodic signal; an integrator configured to accumulate and add a signal in which the DC signal and the periodic signal are multiplied; and a voltage summer configured to sum a signal output from the integrator with a reference voltage to calculate a capacitance control voltage to be applied to the voltage-controlled variable capacitance device.

title: Switching value input signal acquisition circuit and method with self-detection and low power consumption
abstract: The invention relates to a switching value input signal acquisition circuit with self-detection and low power consumption and a method thereof, wherein the circuit is connected with an MCU, and is characterized in that, the acquisition circuit comprises a path of opening self-checking loop and at least one path of opening acquisition loop which are respectively connected with the MCU, and the path of opening self-checking loop is respectively connected with each path of opening acquisition loop. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of universal AC/DC, improved system reliability and the like.

title: Dynamic range adjustment for analog-to-digital converter
abstract: Certain aspects are directed to an apparatus configured for wireless communication. The apparatus may include a memory comprising instructions, and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions. In some examples, the one or more processors are configured to cause the apparatus to obtain a sample of an analog signal. In some examples, the one or more processors are configured to cause the apparatus to output the sample to an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) via one of at least a first path or a second path based at least in part on whether the sample satisfies a first threshold condition or a second threshold condition.

title: Flight control system for vertical take-off and landing aircraft
abstract: The invention relates to the field of flight control, and in particular discloses a flight control system for a vertical take-off and landing aircraft, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a data acquisition module, an obstacle detection module, an obstacle recheck module, an obstacle identification module, a distance measurement and calculation module and an aircraft control module. The invention acquires the image in the advancing direction, acquires the obstacle in the advancing direction and acquires the maximum size of the obstacle, thereby automatically controlling the aircraft to complete the avoidance of the obstacle, the operation difficulty of an operator is reduced, the collision between the aircraft and the obstacle is prevented, and the size of the shot video frames is adjusted, so that when each video frame is processed, the erroneous judgment of data caused by the size or the camera shake is avoided.

title: Anti-adhesion and insufficient-welding flip-chip welding method
abstract: The invention discloses a flip-chip welding method for preventing adhesion and cold joint, which is used for welding a chip on a substrate, wherein the welding surface of the chip is provided with a plurality of first welding spots, the substrate is provided with a welding pad area corresponding to the welding surface, the welding pad area is provided with a plurality of second welding spots corresponding to the first welding spots, and the flip-chip welding method comprises the steps of coating tin paste on the plurality of second welding spots; placing at least three support members which are not on the same straight line at a second welding point positioned at the edge of the pad area, wherein each support member is positioned at a second welding point; heating the pad area to melt the solder paste into solder balls, and melting the supporting pieces into the solder balls; placing the chip on the substrate, and enabling the welding surface to face the pad area; heating the substrate and/or the chip and pressing the chip towards the substrate to melt the solder balls and weld the solder balls with the corresponding first welding points; the support is abutted against the chip and the substrate to limit the distance between the chip and the substrate. The technical scheme of the invention can solve the problem that flip chip bonding is easy to generate insufficient solder and adhesion.

title: Drive apparatus for moving a darkening, moving or closing device
abstract: The invention relates to a drive apparatus (20) for moving a darkening, moving or closing device (18), in particular in the form of a curtain, rolling gate, garage door, roller shutter, room divider, fire curtain, sliding gate, folding gate, slats, an adjustable platform or the like, comprising: a drive motor (2), which can be driven by means of an electric drive signal, for moving the darkening, moving or closing device (18), wherein the drive motor (2) has a motor controller connected to an open-loop and/or closed-loop control device (10) for controlling the darkening, moving or closing device (18), or is connected to a motor controller of this kind; and comprising a transmission (1) which is located in the drivetrain between the output shaft of the drive motor (2) and the input shaft (21) of the darkening, moving or closing device (18). According to the invention, the apparatus (20) has a sensor and analysis unit (8) which is mechanically fixedly connected to the apparatus (20) for the purposes of diagnostics and analysis, in particular for determining a state of wear of the drive apparatus (20) and/or the drive motor (2) and/or the transmission (1) and/or a first brake (3) and/or the darkening, moving or closing device (18), wherein characteristic data of the drive apparatus (10) in the form of an electronic nameplate (45) are stored in the sensor and analysis unit (8), and wherein the sensor and analysis unit (8) is connected to the open-loop and/or closed-loop control device (10) for transmitting and receiving data.

title: Nail beauty lamp convenient to disassemble
abstract: The utility model relates to a nail lamp convenient to disassemble, which comprises a shell, wherein a drying cavity is arranged in the shell; the lamp holder is arranged at the top of the shell, and the bottom of the lamp holder is fixedly provided with a UV lamp tube; the lamp holder is characterized in that fixing components are arranged on two sides of the lamp holder respectively and comprise telescopic supporting columns, return springs and protruding blocks, mounting holes are formed in two sides of the lamp holder respectively, and the telescopic supporting columns are fixedly arranged in the mounting holes. The utility model discloses can make the lug receive reset spring's elasticity move to the shell spacing downthehole in the in-process of installing the lighting fixture, thereby can fix the lighting fixture, the in-process that prevents to use makes the lighting fixture take place not hard up and drop, when needs are changed the UV fluorescent tube, only need hold between the fingers two plectrums with the hand and be close to each other and just can drive the slider and remove, thereby can extrude the lug from the mounting hole, then only need to lift the lighting fixture upwards with the hand and can take out the lighting fixture, be convenient for dismantle and change the fluorescent tube.

title: Bending-resistant power cable
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of power lines, and provides a bending-resistant power cable which comprises a power transmission line and a signal transmission line, wherein the power transmission line is provided with a plurality of local circumference arrays, the signal transmission line comprises a plurality of first conductors and a plurality of first filling glass fiber ropes, the first conductors are layered and stranded by adopting a pitch, a signal line sheath is arranged on the peripheries of the first conductors and the first filling glass fiber ropes, and the signal line sheath is formed by braiding a plurality of superconductive filaments; the power transmission line and the signal transmission line are distributed in a round shape integrally, and second filling glass fiber ropes are arranged at the intersection points of the power transmission line and the circle center extension lines of the signal transmission lines. Based on this, the power cable that utilizes this structure wholly possesses good bending resistance, also can possess certain compliance under the strength structure that keeps, and the process installation of being convenient for uses, and the practicality is strong.
